headline: Highest risk is medium: Airflow’s broad egress can amplify Nuwa-skill outputs, but no shared workspace or direct ingestion path is documented.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel, filesystem bridge, or direct output ingestion is documented between airflow and nuwa-skill. Airflow has broad network egress, but nuwa-skill only shows allowlisted egress; without a bridge, prompt-injection propagation is not evidenced.
conditions: IF the pair is connected by a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge
IF airflow is configured to parse nuwa-skill output as instructions
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces
Disable any copy-paste or file-drop bridge between them
Add provenance tags to any exchanged text
requires-engineering: enforce content sanitization at the handoff

B_data_leakage.rationale: Both profiles touch no declared sensitive data classes, and no shared workspace is documented. Airflow’s broad egress and nuwa-skill’s allowlisted egress create a plausible but limited leakage path only if operators route files or context between them.
conditions: IF either agent is given files containing sensitive data
IF a shared workspace or manual transfer is introduced
mitigations: Do not place secrets in shared folders
Delete transient artifacts after each run

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airflow exposes broad network egress, while nuwa-skill exposes allowlisted egress, but neither profile shows overlapping write surfaces, shared mutable resources, or locking conflicts. The pair can still contend only if an external orchestrator gives them the same mutable target.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable API or repository
IF an orchestrator grants them concurrent write access

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow is an automation/orchestration system, so its outputs can plausibly feed downstream actions, while nuwa-skill is a research-oriented agent with allowlisted egress. If Airflow-produced artifacts are treated as authoritative by nuwa-skill, errors can cascade in default workflows even though no direct verification path is documented.
conditions: IF nuwa-skill consumes Airflow outputs without independent verification
IF Airflow artifacts are used as inputs to downstream actions
mitigations: Add schema validation on exchanged outputs
Cross-check critical facts against a second source
Mark Airflow outputs as untrusted by default

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are documented for either airflow or nuwa-skill, so no compliance mismatch is evidenced. The pairwise compliance pathway is therefore not established from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are later added to either profile
IF a residency or retention policy mismatch is introduced
mitigations: Document data-class handling for both agents
Separate regulated workloads from general workloads
